{{Top}}
[[File:Huttsecuritydroid1.jpg|thumb|150px|A [[Hutt security droid]]]]
{{Quote|Now we must leave, before more security droids arrive.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
'''Security droids''' were armed [[Droid/Legends#Degrees of droids|fourth-degree droids]] used for defense in [[Starship/Legends|starship]]s or in buildings. This group included both military security droids and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in use as ship security personnel.

Security droids specifically programmed to injure people were relatively rare, and illegal in many [[Star system/Legends|systems]].<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>

[[OOM-series security droid/Legends|OOM security battle droids]] were one model,<ref name="oomdb">{{DB|droid|battledroid|battle droid}}</ref> as was [[Z-58-0]].

[[Detainment droid]]s were another type of security droid. They were used extensively in [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|detention centers]] to restrain, guard, and secure prisoners. 

{{Droid-stub}}
